reason: I already have an inverter and battery at home. A normal semi-automatic costs about ₹10,000 to ₹12,000, so I am paying almost double for a battery I mostly do not need. If cuts get worse I would sooner put that money into a bigger inverter battery that runs everything, not only the washer.
objection: Why pay for a second battery that only runs the washing machine when my inverter is already sitting there? And a lithium battery is one more thing to go bad after the 3-year warranty, and then who knows what the dealer will charge to replace it.
would_change_my_mind: If the dealer showed me that my inverter really cannot handle a washer motor, and the price came down to around ₹15,000 with the battery replacement cost written down.
